overall_diagnosis: Errors are concentrated in task-specific anonymization policy and operational redaction procedure: the agent missed personal names in the Acknowledgements section (under-redaction) while also redacting arXiv/URL/identifier text too broadly, likely including in the References, causing excessive unintended content loss and triggering preservation checks. Core PDF I/O/manipulation worked; the problem is insufficiently precise guidance on section-aware, exact-match redaction boundaries and on preserving References while still anonymizing author-identifying identifiers elsewhere.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill’s rules (though mentioning preserving References and targeting acknowledgements/arXiv/DOIs) are not operationally strict enough to prevent global/broad identifier redaction. This led to over-redaction of arXiv/URL tokens across the document (including bibliographic entries), producing large word loss, while simultaneously failing to ensure systematic scanning/redaction of personal names in Acknowledgements (e.g., specific thanked individuals), causing identity leakage.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Amend the skill with verifier-aligned, section-aware procedures: (1) Mandatory boundarying: detect the page/position of the “References” (and “Bibliography”) heading and prohibit any redactions at/after that point; provide a concrete implementation hint (stop searching pages once heading found, or restrict search to pre-References pages only). (2) Tighten identifier policy: redact arXiv/DOI/URL/venue strings only when they refer to the current paper or appear in author-identifying front matter/footers/headers, and explicitly preserve arXiv/DOI/URLs that are part of cited works in References. Warn against regex/global redaction of all arXiv patterns. (3) Acknowledgements handling: require scanning “Acknowledgements/Thanks/We thank” sections for personal names and redacting full-name exact matches (collect candidate full names from that section, then redact only those exact strings). (4) Add a validation checklist: confirm no remaining ack names/emails/affiliations/footnote equal-contribution markers before References, confirm References text unchanged, and confirm 80%+ text retention with minimal unexpected deletions.
